comparisons.peer_summary: Total revenue for 2024 increased 62% compared to 2023, driven by a 60% increase in DRAM sales (due to mid-40% bit shipment growth and low-teen ASP growth) and a 72% increase in NAND sales (due to low-30% bit shipment growth and low-30% ASP growth).
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and Micron report significant total revenue growth for fiscal year 2024 compared to the prior year, driven by strong demand in their respective semiconductor segments. NVIDIA attributes its 126% revenue increase to its Data Center business, while Micron reports a 62% increase driven by higher bit shipments and average selling prices in both DRAM and NAND products. NVIDIA's growth magnitude was higher (126% vs 62%), but both disclosures highlight similar drivers of volume growth (shipments/Bit growth for Micron, hyperscale/AI demand for NVIDIA) leading to substantial year-over-year top-line expansion.

sentences.text: Revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $60.9 billion, up 126% from a year ago.
Total revenue for 2024 increased 62% as compared to 2023 primarily due to increases in sales of both DRAM and NAND products.
• Sales of DRAM products increased 60% primarily due to a mid-40% range increase in bit shipments and a low-teen percentage range increase in average selling prices.
• Sales of NAND products increased 72% primarily due to a low-30% range increase in bit shipments and a low-30% percentage range increase in average selling prices.
